title: Binance Plans Pricing | APIs.io Plans
snippet:
Binance does not charge for API access itself; commercial pricing is expressed as spot/futures trading commissions and a tiered VIP fee schedule based on 30-day trading volume and BNB holdings. API connectivity, market data, and WebSocket streams are provided at no cost to authenticated users; revenue is captured per-trade. Higher VIP tiers also confer raised request weight ceilings.
Binance Plans Pricing is the machine-readable pricing-plan profile for [Binance](https://providers.apis.io/providers/binance/) on the [APIs.io](https://apis.io/) network, conforming to the [API Commons Plans](https://apicommons.org/) specification.
It defines 4 plans, covering freemium, usage-based, tiered, and enterprise tiers, with named plans including *API Access (No Fee)*, *Spot Trading - Regular User*, *Spot Trading - VIP Tiers*, *Institutional / Broker*.

title: Fast API
snippet:
### Minimum requirements for Fast API:
- `account:status`
- `create:apikey` (For Spot & Margin trading permission, and Futures trading permission) *Or* `create:apikey:margin` (For Margin Loan, repay, and Transfer permission) *Or* `create:apikey:options` (For European Options Trading permission)
- `user:openId`

title: How to apply partner developer account
Crypto-As-A-Service — Integration Guideline | Binance Developer Docs
snippet:
Crypto-As-A-Service lets a platform offer crypto functionality to its users without building an exchange, custody, wallet, trading, or settlement stack. Your application connects to Binance from your own backend; you build the front end, and Binance provides the account, custody, and execution layer.
### Core capabilities
| Capability | What you get |
|---|---|
| Sub-account management | One Binance account per end user, created and controlled through your master account. |
| Per-user API credentials | An API key scoped to a single sub-account, with configurable permissions and IP controls. |
| Asset movement | Transfers between your master account and its sub-accounts across spot, margin, futures. |
| Commission | Set and query the commission you earn on each sub-account's spot and futures activity. |
| Optional modules | KYC SaaS, Markup, and the Institutional Crypto Buy/Sell Solution. |
### Architecture
CAAS is a server-to-server integration. There is no Binance-hosted interface for your end users.
```
CodeYour front end  ──►  Your backend  ──►  CAAS API (/sapi/v1/broker/*)
│                    master account API key
└────────────►  Trading APIs (/api, /fapi, /dapi)
sub-account API key
```

CAAS itself does not require you to register your calling IP addresses with Binance. IP allowlisting at onboarding applies to [KYC SaaS](https://developers.binance.com/en/docs/products/kyc-saas/overview) and the [Institutional Crypto Buy/Sell Solution](https://developers.binance.com/en/docs/products/institutional-buy-sell/introduction) only. You can still restrict the sub-account API keys you create — see [section 6](https://developers.binance.com/en/docs/products/caas/integration-guide#6-step-by-step-end-user-onboarding).
